title: Roamhaven Rewards Member Terms — Arrival-Day Courtesy on a Travel-Issue Fee Refund
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards member terms — arrival-day courtesy on the travel-issue service-fee refund

On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, Roamhaven Rewards members who report the issue on the day they arrive get a courtesy on the fee base, the arrival night's price being the nightly subtotal divided by the stay's nights rounded half up to the cent.

1. When the request was submitted on the check-in date and the guest's active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge, 100 percent of the arrival night's price is added to the travel-issue fee base.
2. When the request was submitted on the check-in date and the guest's active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge, 50 percent of it is added.
3. Otherwise none of it is added.

The courtesy amount is rounded half up to the cent. The guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record — tier, tier features and whether it is active — decides which term applies.

## Illustration (hypothetical: nightly subtotal 1,000.00 over 3 nights)

The arrival night's price is 1,000.00 divided by 3, which is 333.33. A concierge member reporting on the check-in date adds 333.33 to the fee base; a priority-support member adds 166.665, rounded half up to 166.67; a member reporting the next day adds nothing.
